#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

static long long ch[61][61];
static int cntA[61], cntB[61];
static long long best;
static string str;
static map<long long, long long> cache;
static int R, C;

long long readLong() {
    long long ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    int c;
    bool start = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            start = true;
            neg = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            start = true;
            ans = ans * 10 + (c - '0');
        } else if (start) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
}

int readInt() {
    int ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    int c;
    bool start = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            start = true;
            neg = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            start = true;
            ans = ans * 10 + (c - '0');
        } else if (start) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
}

string readString() {
    string b;
    int c;
    bool start = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (!isspace(c)) {
            start = true;
            b += (char)c;
        } else if (start) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return b;
}

void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long diff = abs(x - y);
    if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
    if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
        if (diff < best) best = diff;
        return;
    }
    if (v1 >= R) {
        long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
        long long other = ch[v2][R];
        dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 >= R) {
        long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
        long long other = ch[v1][R];
        dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
}

long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long diff = abs(x - y);
    if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
    long long key = (v1 ^ v2 ^ (int)(x & 0xFF)) + ((v1 + v2) << 16);
    if (cache.find(key) != cache.end()) return cache[key];
    if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
        if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
            int sum = v1 + v2;
            v1 -= cntA[sum];
            v2 -= cntB[sum];
            return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
        }
        return 0;
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    char c = str[v1 + v2 - 1];
    if (c != 'B') {
        long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
        long long other = ch[v2][R];
        ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (c != 'A') {
        long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
        long long other = ch[v1][R];
        ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    cache[key] = ans;
    return ans;
}

void start() {
    R = readInt();
    C = readInt();
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (R + C); i++)
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++)
            if (j == 0 || j == i) ch[i][j] = 1;
            else ch[i][j] = ch[i - 1][j - 1] + ch[i - 1][j];
    long long x = 0, y = 0;
    int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
    while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R)
        if (x > y) {
            long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v2][R];
            y += cur * other;
            v1--;
        } else {
            long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v1][R];
            x += cur * other;
            v2--;
        }
    best = abs(x - y);
    dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    str = readString();
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    long long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    start();
    return 0;
}
